page.layout: Two columns of index entries, side by side on one printed page. Left column first, then right column. Each column runs from top to bottom with page numbers at the end of each line. Section letters D and E stand alone above their entries. The catchword "inter" sits at the lower right.

page.notes: Faint show-through of the page opposite is present at the top and is not transcribed. "stationem" (Christi regnum entry) is a reading from partly obscured letters, so it is marked [?]. "nonmpt" (Episcopi entry) is garbled on the scan, marked [?]. "Fracisci" and "delides" are printed as shown, probably printing errors for Francisci and desides. Drop-cap D of "DAemonium" is joined to the word as printed. No page number is printed.
